SEL falsification experiment: exact exhaustive actual-block leakage triples
12 independent seeds; Gaussian covariance-law port; c=1, sigma=1, A=2, epsilon0=1.
p(n)=5*ceil(max(1000,n/2)/5); both fixed support layouts exercised.
No simulations of response noise or claims about start-mode recovery.
Q0 maximum is over T0 induced by actual blocks, not the entire enlarged deterministic family.
Numerics target n^(3/8) only asymptotically; finite-n exceedances alone do not refute SEL.
